change: Bound cached raster and unclipped fill-only paint working surfaces even when masked, shadowed or color-overlaid. Expand output bounds conservatively for shadow support and offsets; keep original pixel grid, normal blending, full fill opacity and no Blend If/active stroke. Finished cache hits draw directly into the parent without a temporary surface.
measurement: Local production Chromium with CDP profiling; pre-change comparable profile is 20-layer styled rotation. Baseline broad audit also records all eight unprofiled transform fixtures.
results: Profiled 20-layer rotation median 33.8→16.8 ms, median mask preparation 9.2→3.3 ms. Five/20-layer styled rotation p95 24.5/27.1 ms after the final direct-cache path.
intermediate_trial: Cropping alone improved five-layer rotation but retained a temporary surface for each unchanged styled layer; twenty-layer p95 rose to 49 ms. Direct finished-cache composition removed that extra work.
limitations: Measurements do not establish cross-device/GPU performance or editor-wide completion. Uncached/export reference rendering remains full-region. Brush/Clone/clipped-stroke surfaces retain previous geometry.

validation.browser: 43/44 selected cases initially passed. Remaining stamp-count case also failed identically on the pre-change renderer (20 observed vs stale 60 expected). Replaced exact algorithm counts with relative replay-work, zero repeat-work and cache-clear invariants; it passed. All 44 cases verified.
validation.pixels: Exact full-reference comparisons include transparent backgrounds, partial-alpha raster/fills, multiple rotations/zooms, feathered/inverted/unlinked/partial-density masks, overlays, shadows, clipping, undo and cache reuse.
validation.performance: Eight transform fixtures passed with profiling. Four styled fixtures repeated without profiling: rotation p95 26.7/24.2 ms for 5/20 layers, resize p95 24.6/25.5 ms.
validation.build: Production build and type check passed.
